record.title: Missing ownership check
record.description: An attacker can reach an operation without the intended ownership check.

evidence.description: The source performs the operation without the required check.

record.root_cause: handle omits the ownership check before changing the object.
record.intended_behavior: Only the object's owner can change it.

execution.attacker_perspective: An unprivileged remote user with their own account.
payloads: An object identifier owned by another user.
instructions: Submit the identifier through the public operation.

remediation.strategy: Check ownership before the state change.

impact.reason: The attacker changes one protected object.

confidence.reason: The source path and result were reproduced.
